title: Amazon.com, Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: AWS sales increased 37% in Q2 2026, and 33% for the six months ended June 30, 2026.
summary: The SEC-filed Q2 2026 Form 10-Q reports quarterly net sales of USD 200.606 billion and operating income of USD 27.461 billion, with six-month net sales of USD 382.125 billion and operating income of USD 51.313 billion. Trailing-twelve-month operating cash flow was USD 161.403 billion, but purchases of property and equipment net of proceeds and incentives produced a USD 7.604 billion free-cash-flow outflow. At June 30, cash and marketable securities totaled USD 122.988 billion, long-term debt was USD 128.894 billion, long-term lease liabilities were USD 94.338 billion, 10.783 billion shares were outstanding, and 244.4 million restricted stock units remained outstanding.
